name: Brand Discovery
purpose: Turn fragmented founder/client/business information into a canonical brand discovery brief separating facts, claims, aspirations, hypotheses and non-negotiables, mapping references/anti-references by underlying quality.
triggers: starting or repositioning a brand with no canonical discovery brief yet
client/founder discovery data exists (interviews, materials, analytics, competitor notes) and needs a single trustworthy foundation
brand-strategy needs a foundation and none exists yet or the existing one is stale
non_triggers: final positioning or a chosen brand strategy
logo design or any visual identity/visual-system decision
generic moodboard generation disconnected from stated references
general project canon unrelated to brand (use canonical-context-builder)
deep external market/competitor research beyond supplied material (use research-architect)
minimum_inputs: raw client/project/business context: what the business does, who it serves, why discovery is happening now
quality_gates: discovery gap list is decision-relevant only (materiality filter applied)
stop_conditions: all three required artifacts produced, every statement classified, contradictions/gaps logged not resolved -> COMPLETE
source material too sparse for even business/offer/customer basics -> BLOCKED, state exactly what additional material is needed, still emit minimal brief + gaps
never state a positioning decision, resolve a contradiction on its own authority, or present a claim/aspiration as verified fact
